subject.title: refactor: remove browser and codex dead exports

question: Should this PR retain the overlapping TypeScript LOC-ratchet repair, or be narrowed after rebase so https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105919 owns that automation change?
rationale: Both branches contain substantive automation changes, while this PR is already conflict-dirty and also carries an already-merged QA fix; choosing one canonical automation owner avoids divergent ratchet behavior and unnecessary conflict resolution.

options.title: Narrow to export cleanup
options.body: Rebase, drop the merged QA commits and overlapping LOC-ratchet change, and let the dedicated open automation PR own that behavior.

options.title: Keep the combined repair
options.body: Retain the LOC-ratchet change here only after reconciling or closing the overlapping PR and reviewing the exact merged automation behavior.

options.title: Pause until overlap lands
options.body: Wait for the automation PR to land, then rebase this branch and keep only its remaining unique cleanup.

recommendation.title: Narrow to export cleanup
recommendation.body: Rebase, drop the merged QA commits and overlapping LOC-ratchet change, and let the dedicated open automation PR own that behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current branch and introduced the merged dead-export ratchet that defines the cleanup, while coordinating directly with the adjacent automation owner.
